name: Zhukov Obscurance
definition: A generalization of ambient occlusion where the visibility function is replaced by a distance suitability function $\rho(d(x, \omega))$, measuring ambient light magnitude based on the distance to the first intersection.
summary: Zhukov Obscurance is a local illumination approximation that replaces binary visibility with a distance-based suitability function to create smooth ambient occlusion gradients.
